_design_note:
The rainbow recipe trained on a mixed table instead of three rule_based_agent. docs/01 section 7.43 measured the rainbow arm's kill advantage as opponent-specific: 4.91x against the rule_based it trained on, 1.1-1.9x against agents it had never met. The tournament is played against other groups' agents, so the training opponents are diversified: one rule_based_agent (the framework's best dodger), one frozen copy of the rainbow submission checkpoint (a neural agent that hunts), and one frozen copy of the M4 opponents+BC checkpoint (a neural agent that survives). The single-frozen-opponent self-play arm of section 7.43.5 collapsed by symmetry -- three identical copies of one policy -- and this table is built to avoid that: no two seats are the same policy and one of them is scripted.

Budget 15000 rounds: the rainbow kill curve was still rising between 7000 and 10000 (0.364 to 0.393, section 7.41.1) while its loot-crate curve was flat. The prioritized replay's importance-sampling anneal is stretched to match (1.8M gradient steps).

Evaluation keeps the 3x rule_based tournament suite so the score stays comparable with every earlier arm; the tournament proxy pool (scripts/tournament_pool.py) is the selection instrument and is run on the finished checkpoints separately.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: Two against the rainbow arm: the training table (3x rule_based -> rule_based + frozen rainbow + frozen M4 oppbc) and the budget (10000 -> 15000). Declared as two; the 10000-round checkpoint is evaluated so the budget half can be read off the same run.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/rep_rainbow_n35 (rainbow @10000 on 3x rule_based, 35 repeats, 5.7975) for the familiar table; the transfer cells of section 7.45 for unfamiliar opponents.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: If the pool mean is not above the rainbow submission's on the proxy pool, opponent diversity does not transfer the kill skill and the submission stays a single-table arm.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: Lower than 5.80 on the 3x rule_based suite (that number was bought by overfitting to rule_based), higher than rainbow's 2.85 on the unfamiliar-opponent cells, and kills that survive an opponent swap better than 1.1-1.9x.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training seeds, kills beside score, the 10000 and 15000 checkpoints side by side, and the proxy pool as the selection number.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reproducibility: rule_based_agent seeds from system entropy; the two frozen seats are deterministic. Repeat measurements against rule_based add information; against the frozen seats only board seeds do.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_mechanism_check: mean_importance_weight below 1.0, mean_target inside [-2, 12], mean_noise_scale away from zero at the end. Additionally: the frozen seats must appear in the framework log as agents; a job whose opponents fell back to anything else is not this arm.
